parole.significato: any athletic activity that uses physical skills
parole.testo: A literary loan from Icelandic íþrótt, during a surging interest for Norse culture and literature during the 19th century. Cognate to Old Swedish iþræt (“profession, craft”) and Early Modern Swedish idrett, idrätt (“occupation”), Danish idræt, all from Old Norse íþrótt, from ið + þróttr.
From Icelandic jökull, from Old Norse jǫkull, diminutive of the Old Norse jaki (“a piece of ice, broken ice”).
Borrowed from Icelandic seiður or Old Norse seiðr. First attested in 1712.
